result_revision.change_summary: Initial dev result for the released CarBench checkpoint.

methodology.record_note: Released CarBench checkpoint (carbench-weights-v1.0, pointnet.pth) run unchanged; every native surface point of all 1,154 official_test designs is predicted directly. Training compute is from the recorded run.

architecture.description: PointNet segmentation-style regressor: shared per-point MLPs with a global max-pooled feature, predicting per-point pressure from coordinates.

components.description: PointNet segmentation-style regressor: shared per-point MLPs with a global max-pooled feature, predicting per-point pressure from coordinates.

input_features.name: surface_coordinates
input_features.description: Native surface-point x/y/z in metres, normalized with training-set statistics.

predicted_fields.description: Kinematic gauge pressure (m^2/s^2) at every native surface point, denormalized with training-set mean and standard deviation.

data_handling.normalization: Pressure standardized with training-split mean -94.5 and standard deviation 117.25 m^2/s^2; predictions are de-standardized before writing.
data_handling.preprocessing: Native surface read unchanged; no remeshing.
data_handling.sampling: Training: one fixed 10,000-point random subsample of native surface points per design, preprocessed once and cached. Inference: ceil(N/10000) disjoint seeded random 10,000-point passes cover every native point once; the final pass is padded with already-predicted points for context and only new points are kept.

stages.description: Supervised training on the official DrivAerNet++ training split with model selection on the official validation split.

loss.description: Mean-squared error on standardized pressure at the sampled surface points.

duration.description: 58 epochs run; the released checkpoint is the lowest validation-loss epoch (38).

compute.measurement_notes: Recorded run PointNet_results_20250923_231623 (best epoch 38, batch 12): 0.44 h total training wall time. Single run with PyTorch DataParallel (multi_gpu enabled) on a 4 x A100-SXM4-80GB machine; the visible device count was not recorded and is assumed to be all four.

checkpoints.bytes_description: Raw bytes of pointnet.pth from the CarBench v1.0 weights release, loaded unchanged.
checkpoints.role: Exact loaded checkpoint for every prediction.
checkpoints.selection_rule: Lowest official-validation loss, selected before any test-case inference.

inference_compute.hardware: 1 x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB shared with other inference processes
inference_compute.measurement_notes: Wall time from first to last prediction file. Ran concurrently with up to nine other inference processes across two GPUs. Includes VTK reading, preprocessing, all passes and serialization; excludes model loading and the FluidsBench evaluator.

note: Dev result for a released CarBench checkpoint; not owner-approved and not an official result.

evaluation.command: python scripts/drivaernetplusplus.py evaluate-entry pointnet-entry --output work/pointnet --resume && python scripts/drivaernetplusplus.py package --evaluation-root work/pointnet/evaluation --config package-config-pointnet.json --discretization-cases discretization-cases.jsonl --checkpoint carbench-pointnet=pointnet.pth --output submissions/drivaernetplusplus/drivaernetplusplus-carbench-pointnet-dev-v1
